## Summary

Revenue for the week ending `r format(Sys.Date(), "%d %B")`, from the orders export.

```{r}
#| label: load
#| message: false
library(dplyr)
orders <- read.csv("orders.csv")
paid <- orders |> filter(status == "paid")
```

Paid orders: **`r nrow(paid)`**, revenue **`r sprintf("£%.2f", sum(paid$total))`**.

```{python}
#| label: plot
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
plt.plot([1, 2, 3], [120.5, 98.0, 143.2]); plt.title("Daily revenue")
```

::: {.callout-note}
Cancelled orders are excluded before totalling.
:::
